lss.config.receive_server_lods.tooltip: Download distant terrain (LODs) from this server. Turn off to stop all LOD downloads.
lss.config.lod_distance.tooltip: How far distant terrain loads, in chunks. 0 uses the server's distance.
lss.config.column_rate_limit.tooltip: Limits how fast LODs download. Lower it if LOD loading stutters your game or slows your connection. 0 means unlimited.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip: LODs download gently right after you join and speed up on their own. Keeps joining smooth on slow connections. Turn off to download at full speed from the first second.
lss.config.join_slow_start.tooltip.gover: LODs download gently right after you join and speed up on their own. Has no effect right now: the adaptive transfer rate setting is disabled in your client config file.
lss.config.xaero_map_bridge.tooltip: Record downloaded distant terrain in Xaero's World Map (1.42.0+), so the map fills in far beyond your render distance. While the map is catching up, LOD downloads are paced to what it can draw — including brief pauses while the map is busy writing terrain around you — so the map keeps up while it can write (slightly slower terrain fill). If the map cannot write for a long stretch (showing a cave layer, map locked), downloads resume and that terrain is skipped on the map — revisit or run the clearcache command to backfill it. Turn off to stop writing to the map. Terrain downloaded while this was off is not written later (the mod's clearcache command, run while connected, backfills it), and switching it on without Voxy installed takes effect on the next join.
lss.config.xaero_map_bridge.tooltip.not_: Record downloaded distant terrain in Xaero's World Map, so the map fills in far beyond your render distance. Has no effect right now: Xaero's World Map is not installed.
lss.config.far_players_enabled.tooltip: See other players far beyond normal render distance, shown as simple player models in the distant terrain. Needs a server with far players enabled.
lss.config.far_players_share_self.toolti: Let faraway players see where you are, as a distant player model. Turn off to stay hidden beyond normal render distance. Note: this choice reaches the server only while LODs are connected. Server exclude lists, permissions, and vanish always hide you regardless.
lss.config.far_players_name_tags.tooltip: Show name tags over far-player models.
lss.config.far_players_render_distance.t: How far away (in blocks) far players are still drawn. Match it to your fog distance if players popping in at the horizon bothers you. 0 follows the server's limit.
lss.config.far_players_enabled.tooltip.s: See other players far beyond normal render distance, shown as simple player models. Disabled right now: SeeU is installed and draws far players itself. Turn on 'Prefer LSS Far Players' below to use this instead.
lss.config.far_players_with_seeu.tooltip: Draw far players with this mod even though SeeU is installed. Leave off if SeeU handles them. If you turn this on, disable SeeU's own display so players are not drawn twice.
